label: Full accessible absence coverage entails witness preservation
meaning: For the same frame, selector and origin, an accessible effect-present source-absence witness lies among the worlds selected by full coverage. The same witness satisfies the weaker premise. Full coverage is the sole premise.

strong_version_needed.06047f4c-ce98-4a33-a3f2-84fcf476d86e: The full policy is the subject of the strength comparison. Witness preservation is its conclusion.
